title: feat(grid): inline validation, duplicate row, drag-to-reorder
body:
## Why

P1 polish for the line-item grid — the per-cell feedback and row affordances enterprise editors (NetSuite, Dynamics, QuickBooks) all have.

## What

- **Inline per-cell validation** — a required, non-computed cell that's empty on a real (non-ghost) row flags red in place (`aria-invalid` + inset ring + `title`), so users see what's missing without submitting. The trailing ghost row is never flagged.
- **Duplicate row** — a hover Copy action clones a line (id stripped, so the copy persists as a new record) directly below the original.
- **Drag-to-reorder** — a hover grip handle reorders rows via native HTML5 drag-and-drop (no new dependency). Set `sort_field` on the grid config to persist order (`row[sortField] = index` stamped on every change); without it, reorder is order-of-entry.

## Verification

- Unit: 22 `GridField` tests (incl. duplicate strips id + inserts below; required-empty cell flags on the data row but not the ghost).
- Live e2e: 9 passing (no regression from the row-render changes).
- Browser-verified on New Invoice: empty required Product + Qty cells flag red; duplicate + drag handle appear on row hover.
